name: framer-draggable-carousel
title: Framer Draggable Carousel
blurb: Draggable image carousel with momentum-less snap animation.
description: Full-width carousel with drag-to-navigate interaction. Images snap to grid on release with spring physics. Elastic drag resistance prevents over-dragging.
use_when: Interactive image galleries where users want manual swipe/drag control.
avoid_when: Mobile-only designs; complex drag logic may perform poorly on touch.
a11y: Drag-only control; no keyboard alternative for navigation.
